description: Design a loop from the current session — turn intent into a sharp goal plus typed, checkable verification, then compile it to artifacts auto runs unchanged. Use when the user says "design a loop", "structure this run", "help me shape a goal and verification for this", "what should the done-condition be", or when /auto routes a session that needs structuring before it runs. This skill COACHES (rubric-driven, seeded from session state — not a blank interview) and compiles to a validated workflow + a goal doc by CALLING auto-author-workflow and auto-author-goal as backends. It writes no parallel spec format (no loop.yaml).
